summary: Kerb lined by houses 6-8 m back along its whole length.
reasons: Dwellings within 10 m along the stretch

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the south kerb at 6-8 m from 25 m to 70 m, and 11 m or less near the start.
drivers.access_and_room: Few cars parked on this side; kerb is open but fronts homes and driveways.
drivers.traffic: Through road with a bend at the west end; cars park on the north side.
drivers.convention: No signs; ordinary residential street kerb.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m rule it out
Tree canopy overhangs part of the kerb
sun_shade: Patchy tree canopy, heavier around 40-55 m; open to midday sun from the north.
